name: Masked Merge
description: Port of FFmpeg's maskedmerge filter: merge the base and overlay clips through a mask.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Base clip (where the mask is black)

inputs.name: overlay
inputs.description: Overlay clip (where the mask is white, same size as the base)

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Mask clip (same size as the base)
